lines.zh: 我在水面上滑行，几乎不出声。
lines.en: I glide across the surface, hardly making a sound.

lines.zh: 身体太重，岸上走不了几步。
lines.en: Too heavy to walk far on land.

lines.zh: 我摆尾往前推，水从两侧分开。
lines.en: My tail drives me forward and the water parts.

lines.zh: 浅水正好，我能贴着底走。
lines.en: The shallows suit me; I can hug the bottom.

lines.zh: 我探出头换了口气，又沉下去。
lines.en: I surface for air, then sink again.
Waves break on my back. I ignore them.
I ride the current's line.
I know this channel well.

lines.zh: 我侧过身子，让过一块礁石。
lines.en: I roll slightly to clear a rock.

lines.zh: 十吨的身子，转个弯也慢。
lines.en: Ten tons does not turn quickly.

lines.zh: 我拖着尾鳍，划开一层水。
lines.en: My fluke cuts a seam through the water.
I patrol once along the shore.

lines.zh: 背上晒着太阳，底下是深水。
lines.en: Sun on my back, deep water below.

lines.zh: 我向前一冲，又滑行一段。
lines.en: One push, then a long glide.

lines.zh: 我浮在水面，只露出脊背。
lines.en: I float with only my back showing.

lines.zh: 鼻孔一开一合，慢慢换气。
lines.en: My nostrils open and close, breathing slow.
The water is still. I wait.

lines.zh: 我的鳍肢垂着，没什么用。
lines.en: My flippers hang, of little use.
I hear something moving below.

lines.zh: 这具身子，在水里才算活得对。
lines.en: This body only feels right in water.

lines.zh: 我把头探出去，看了一圈。
lines.en: I lift my head out and look around.

lines.zh: 岸上那些东西，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: Those things on land do not interest me.
I settle a little deeper.

lines.zh: 阳光透下来，照出我的影子。
lines.en: Sunlight pierces down and casts my shadow.

lines.zh: 我不着急，水里没什么能追我。
lines.en: No hurry; nothing in the water can chase me.

lines.zh: 颚骨合着，牙齿藏在里面。
lines.en: Jaws closed, teeth hidden.
I feel a tremor from far off.
One breath lasts a long while.
You stand on shore, out of my reach.

lines.zh: 岸上那个身影，我盯了很久。
lines.en: I have watched that figure on the shore a long while.
You smell dry.

lines.zh: 我绕着你脚下的岸线游。
lines.en: I swim the shoreline beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 你一退，我就往前进一点。
lines.en: You step back, so I come in a little.
Water lies between us. For now.
Only my eyes show above the surface.
Wondering whether I will come ashore?

lines.zh: 你的小腿，我已经量好了。
lines.en: I have already measured your calf.

lines.zh: 这水里，游得比我快的没有。
lines.en: Nothing here swims faster than I do.
I neither call nor hiss. I only watch.
Come closer to the water and see.

lines.zh: 这疼，让我整个身子一沉。
lines.en: The pain sinks my whole body.
I roar and the water shudders.
Who dares strike me in my water?

lines.zh: 水浸着伤口，我疼得直翻。
lines.en: Water soaks the wound and I writhe with pain.
I roll over to ease it.

lines.zh: 这身皮厚，也挡不住这一下。
lines.en: Even this hide could not stop that.
I beat my tail and back away.
My blood spreads in the water too fast.

lines.zh: 我喘不上气，浮上去换气。
lines.en: I cannot get air; I surface to breathe.
I will remember this wound.

lines.zh: 水里的东西，我才有兴趣。
lines.en: Only what lives in water interests me.
Drop the meat and I will take it.
I open my jaws, then close them.

lines.zh: 我游过来，水面裂开一道。
lines.en: I swim over, splitting the surface.
That much merely lets me taste.
I swallow it, water and all.

lines.zh: 有得吃，我就多待一会儿。
lines.en: With food, I linger a while.
I will not come ashore. Throw it closer.
Not enough. More.
When full, I sink back to the deep.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，像撞船底。
lines.en: You struck me like a hull.

lines.zh: 我侧身一摆，你就滑开了。
lines.en: One roll and you slide off.
My hide is thicker than planking.
You stepped on my back. Steady.
I push you toward deeper water.
That bump is not worth my notice.

lines.zh: 你的船要是撞上我，会散。
lines.en: A boat hitting me would break apart.
I sink and you are left striking nothing.
I brush past your legs underwater.
Move; I need to surface for air.
In deep water we swim side by side.
I touch it gently with my jaw.
This is the quiet season in the water.
We circle the same reef flat.
Its tail beats steadier than mine.

lines.zh: 这么大的身子，也怕惊到它。
lines.en: Even this bulk fears startling it.
We surface for breath together.
This bay could raise our young.
As I near, it turns broadside.

lines.zh: 水一浑，就看不见彼此了。
lines.en: The water clouds and we lose sight of each other.

lines.zh: 水里漂着个东西，我咬住。
lines.en: Something drifts by; I take it in my teeth.
I nudge it to my mouth and test it.
Not meat. I spit it out.
This one is big enough. Mine.
One dip of my head and it is gone.

lines.zh: 沉下去的东西，我也能捡。
lines.en: I can fetch what sinks, too.
I hold it in my jaws and chew slowly.
You threw it; I caught it cleanly.
It grates against my teeth. I dislike it.
Holding it, I swim back to the deep.

lines.zh: 水里有东西在动，我锁住了。
lines.en: Something moves in the water. I have it.

lines.zh: 我转向那个方向，水都推开了。
lines.en: I turn that way and the water shoves aside.
It is in the shallows. Too near.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，换了口气，再下潜。
lines.en: I take a breath, then dive.
From here, one lunge.

lines.zh: 它落水的那一刻，我就知道了。
lines.en: I knew the moment it hit the water.

lines.zh: 我的影子先到了它身上。
lines.en: My shadow reaches it first.

lines.zh: 我选了它，因为它挣不动。
lines.en: I pick it because it cannot struggle free.
I open my jaws and close in slowly.
One beat of my tail and I surge.
It flees deep. Exactly what I want.

lines.zh: 这片水里，没有第二个能救它。
lines.en: There is nothing else here to save it.
I hear the sound of bone.
Coming from below is faster.
I rise slowly beneath it.
It swims frantically; its air runs short.
I press the water and drive it upward.

lines.zh: 它每转一次，我也跟着转。
lines.en: Each turn it makes, I match.
My jaws stay open.

lines.zh: 它撞到浅滩了，退不回去。
lines.en: It has hit the shallows and cannot back off.

lines.zh: 这具身体转向慢，可我不会跟丢。
lines.en: I turn slowly, but I do not lose it.

lines.zh: 水面那道波纹，就是它的路。
lines.en: That wake on the surface is its road.
I wait for it to tire.
My teeth stand in rows.
A little closer and I can close.
It is starting to splash.
I herd it toward the bank.

lines.zh: 这么近，它已经在我嘴里了。
lines.en: This close, it is already in my jaws.
The last circle closes.

lines.zh: 我一张口，整排牙都进去了。
lines.en: My jaws open and the whole row goes in.

lines.zh: 我咬住脊背，一拧就断了。
lines.en: I bite its spine and twist until it snaps.
That bite shattered bone.
I drag it down to the bottom.
Ten tons of me bears down.

lines.zh: 我用颚骨撞，不用牙也行。
lines.en: I could ram with my jaw alone.
The water goes red all at once.

lines.zh: 它在我嘴里挣了两下，软了。
lines.en: It struggles twice in my jaws, then goes limp.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的鳍，把它翻过来。
lines.en: I take its fin and roll it over.

lines.zh: 这一口，是冲着脊背去的。
lines.en: That bite was aimed at the spine.

lines.zh: 我往前一送，牙就合上了。
lines.en: One surge forward and the teeth close.

lines.zh: 它被我从水面拖了下去。
lines.en: I pull it under from the surface.
My jaws are wider than a door.
I will eat slowly. No hurry.

lines.zh: 我从深处升起，浪向两边分开。
lines.en: I rise from the depths and the waves part on either side.
There is room here to turn.
The shore is too close for my liking.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口气，水面起了泡。
lines.en: I blow out a breath and the surface bubbles.
Which sea is this? The taste is wrong.
First I sink to look at the bottom.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过水，照在我背上。
lines.en: Sunlight pierces the water onto my back.
My tail stirs up a cloud of mud.

lines.zh: 从那么远的水里，被扔到这。
lines.en: Thrown here from water far away.

lines.zh: 这具身子，只有在水中才不累。
lines.en: This body only rests in water.

lines.zh: 我沿着岸走了一圈，找深水。
lines.en: I work along the shore, hunting deep water.

lines.zh: 我的影子很大，鱼都散了。
lines.en: My shadow is large; the fish scatter.
I raise my head and look at the sky once.
The water here is the right warmth.
I sink three blocks and hide myself.
Empty belly. Find food first.

lines.zh: 远处有岸，那边应该有鱼。
lines.en: There is shore over there. Fish, likely.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，就往深处去了。
lines.en: One beat of my tail and I head for the deep.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的背，皮都起了泡。
lines.en: Fire on my back blisters the hide.

lines.zh: 我砸下来，骨头压得生疼。
lines.en: I crash down and my bones ache.

lines.zh: 我在水里却换不到气，慌了。
lines.en: In water and yet without air. I panic.

lines.zh: 水下炸开，我的耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: It bursts underwater and my ears ring.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西，扎进我的鳍根。
lines.en: Something sharp drove into the base of my flipper.

lines.zh: 这诅咒让我的颚合不上。
lines.en: The hex leaves my jaws unable to close.

lines.zh: 饿得太久，我连摆尾都费劲。
lines.en: Starved this long, even a tailbeat costs me.

lines.zh: 雷从水面劈下来，我眼前一白。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the surface and all goes white.

lines.zh: 下面没有水了，我一直在掉。
lines.en: The water is gone below and I keep falling.
